questions.question: What happens if air pressure is lost in the emergency line?
questions.explanation: The emergency air line controls the emergency brakes. If air pressure is lost in the emergency line, the emergency brakes on the trailer will activate.

questions.question: When connecting a converter dolly to a second trailer, the trailer height should be ____ the center of the fifth wheel.
questions.explanation: When connecting a converter dolly to a second trailer, the trailer should be slightly lower than the center of the fifth wheel.

questions.question: In a sudden turn, which trailer is most likely to tip over?
questions.explanation: When turning with trailers, steer gently and smoothly. Quick turns are dangerous and can cause the last trailer to roll over.

questions.question: After finishing a pre-trip inspection, you should make sure that the:
questions.explanation: Before driving, open the emergency and service line valves to check that air reaches all brake systems. Listen for air escaping. Then close both valves before you start driving.

questions.question: All trailers made after ____ must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS).
questions.explanation: All trailers and converter dollies made on or after March 1, 1998 must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS).

questions.question: An air supply control lever should be in its "normal" position when you are:
questions.explanation: In older vehicles, tractor protection controls use levers instead of knobs. When the air supply control is in its "normal" position, it is ready for you to pull a trailer.

questions.question: How much space should be between the upper and lower fifth wheel?
questions.explanation: Before a trip, inspect all couplings. There should be no space between the upper and lower fifth wheel.

questions.question: In a vehicle with an automatic tractor protection valve, when will the valve pop out?

options.text: When air pressure drops between 20 and 45 psi.
When wheels regain traction after a skid.

questions.correctAnswerText: When air pressure drops between 20 and 45 psi.
questions.explanation: The automatic tractor protection valve will pop out if air pressure drops between 20 and 45 psi. When it pops out, it closes and stops the flow of air.

questions.question: Which action will NOT help prevent a rig from rolling over?

options.text: Keeping cargo as close to the ground as possible
Driving on the shoulder of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving on the shoulder of the road
questions.explanation: To prevent a rig from rolling over, keep cargo weight as close to the ground as possible and drive slowly around turns. Driving on the road shoulder does not help prevent rollovers.

questions.question: What does pushing in the trailer air supply control do?
questions.explanation: Push in the trailer air supply control to send air to the trailer. Pull out the control to turn off the air supply and activate the emergency brakes.

questions.question: How should you test the trailer service brakes?

options.text: Move forward slowly and use the brake pedal.
Move backward slowly and use the hand control.
Move forward slowly and use the hand control.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move forward slowly and use the hand control.
questions.explanation: To test trailer service brakes, first check that air pressure is normal and release the parking brake. Then move forward slowly and apply the brakes using the hand control. If the brakes work properly, you will feel them engage.

questions.question: During a trip, the ____ should be open.
questions.explanation: When starting a trip, keep all shut-off valves open except the last ones on the rear trailer. This ensures air reaches the brakes on all trailers and does not escape from the back of the vehicle.

questions.question: Operating combination vehicles usually requires ____ operating single vehicles.

options.text: About the same level of skill as

questions.explanation: Combination vehicles are heavier and longer than single vehicles. They require higher-level driving skills to operate safely.

questions.question: How can you find out if a vehicle built before 1998 has an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)?

options.text: Pump the air brakes to activate the ABS.
Look inside the back of the fifth wheel.
Check for wheel speed sensors attached to the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for wheel speed sensors attached to the brakes.
questions.explanation: For vehicles built before 1998, check under the trailer for wheel speed sensors attached to the brakes to see if it has an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS).

questions.question: What does an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) do?

options.text: It allows wheels to lock up.
It prevents wheels from locking up.
It makes the vehicle turn easier.

questions.correctAnswerText: It prevents wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) prevents wheel lockup during hard braking. When ABS detects that wheels might lock up, it reduces braking pressure to a safe level.

questions.question: The emergency air line supplies air to the:
questions.explanation: The emergency air line (supply line) has two jobs. It supplies air to the trailer air tanks and controls the emergency brakes on combination vehicles.

questions.question: The ____ trailer is most likely to tip over if a driver turns too quickly.
questions.explanation: When turning, steer gently and smoothly. Quick turns while pulling trailers are dangerous and increase the risk of the last trailer tipping over.

questions.question: If you must cross traffic while driving a combination vehicle, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will make room for your vehicle.
Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to cross safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to cross safely.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles need more road space than other vehicles. When crossing traffic, make sure there is a large enough gap to do so safely.

questions.question: You should not use the trailer hand valve while driving because:

options.text: It will disconnect from the vehicle.

questions.explanation: Never use the trailer hand valve while driving. Using it can cause your trailer to skid.

questions.question: Keeping cargo centered on a rig can:
questions.explanation: Uneven cargo increases the risk of rollover. Keep the load centered on the rig to help prevent dangerous rollovers.
